```{r}
bin16_list_ann <- readRDS("~/data/bin16_list_ann.rds")
c26_samples <- c("c26_b2","c26_b4","c26_b6")
sham_samples <- c("sham_b1","sham_b3","sham_b6")
fox0_samples <- c("c26foxO_b1", "c26foxO_b4", "c26foxO_b6", "c26foxO_b9")
murf_samples <- c("c26murf1_b2", "c26murf1_b3", "c26murf1_b5", "c26murf1_b9")
smad_samples <- c("c26SMAD23_b2", "c26SMAD23_b4", "c26SMAD23_b5", "c26SMAD23_b9")
```

#general summary (to compare with Oliveira gold standard):
```{r}
mat <- counts(bin16_list_ann$c26murf1_b9)
gene_sums <- rowSums(mat)
expressed_counts <- rowSums(mat > 0)
mean_expressed <- gene_sums / expressed_counts
#Expression of the genes in the spots where they are expressed:
summary(mean_expressed)

summary(gene_sums[gene_sums>0])
boxplot(gene_sums)
 
#Proportion of spots where genes are expressed:
summary(rowSums(mat > 0) / 370074) * 100

```


```{r}
counts_inspection <- function(spe_list, samples, genes_list, tissue, output_dir = ".") {
  
  # Crea la cartella di output se non esiste già
  if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) {
    dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)
  }
  
  # Lista per raccogliere l'espressione media per cell type
  mean_expr_list <- list()
  
  for (gene in genes_list) {
    
    # Dataframe temporaneo per raccogliere i dati di tutti i campioni per il gene corrente
    gene_raw_data <- list()
    
    for (spe_name in samples) {
      
      # Verifica se il campione esiste nella lista
      if (!spe_name %in% names(spe_list)) {
        message(paste("Skipping:", spe_name, "non presente in spe_list"))
        next
      }
      
      spe <- spe_list[[spe_name]]
      
      # Verifica se il gene è presente nei dati
      if (!gene %in% rownames(spe)) {
        message(paste("Skipping:", gene, "non in", spe_name))
        next
      }
      
      # Verifica se la colonna "new_cell_type" è presente nei metadati
      if (!"new_cell_type" %in% colnames(colData(spe))) {
        message(paste("Skipping: colonna 'new_cell_type' non trovata in", spe_name))
        next
      }
      
      # Estrazione dei conteggi e dei tipi cellulari
      expr <- as.numeric(counts(spe)[gene, ])
      cell_types <- as.character(colData(spe)[["new_cell_type"]])
      
      # Memorizza i conteggi per il plot aggregato
      gene_raw_data[[spe_name]] <- data.frame(
        counts = expr,
        Cell_Type = cell_types,
        Sample = spe_name,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
      
      # ------------------------------------------------------------------
      # 1. CALCOLO ESPRESSIONE MEDIA PER CELL TYPE
      # ------------------------------------------------------------------
      avg_by_celltype <- tapply(expr, cell_types, mean, na.rm = TRUE)
      
      df_avg <- data.frame(
        Tissue = tissue,
        Sample = spe_name,
        Gene = gene,
        Cell_Type = names(avg_by_celltype),
        Mean_Expression = as.numeric(avg_by_celltype),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
      
      mean_expr_list[[length(mean_expr_list) + 1]] <- df_avg
    }
    
    # Se non sono stati trovati dati per questo gene in nessun campione, passa al prossimo
    if (length(gene_raw_data) == 0) next
    
    # Unione dei dati di tutti i campioni per il gene corrente
    combined_gene_df <- do.call(rbind, gene_raw_data)
    
    # --------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 2. GENERAZIONE E SALVATAGGIO DEI PLOT AGGREGATI (IN UN UNICO FILE)
    # --------------------------------------------------------------------
    
    # A) Istogramma dei conteggi raw (Facettato per Campione)
    hist_filename <- file.path(output_dir, paste0(tissue, "_", gene, "_hist_all_samples.png"))
    
    p_hist <- ggplot(combined_gene_df, aes(x = counts, fill = Sample)) +
      geom_histogram(bins = 30, color = "black", alpha = 0.7, show.legend = FALSE) +
      facet_wrap(~ Sample, scales = "free_y") +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
      labs(
        title = paste("Distribuzione Conteggi Raw:", gene),
        subtitle = paste("Tessuto:", tissue, "| Confronto tra campioni"),
        x = "Conteggi Raw",
        y = "Frequenza (Numero di spot/celle)"
      )
    
    # Calcola la dimensione dinamica dell'immagine in base al numero di campioni
    n_samples <- length(unique(combined_gene_df$Sample))
    plot_width <- min(14, 4 * ceiling(sqrt(n_samples)))
    plot_height <- min(12, 3.5 * ceiling(n_samples / ceiling(sqrt(n_samples))))
    
    ggsave(hist_filename, plot = p_hist, width = plot_width, height = plot_height, dpi = 300)
    
    # B) Grafico dell'Espressione Media per Cell Type (Facettato per Campione)
    combined_mean_gene <- do.call(rbind, mean_expr_list)
    combined_mean_gene <- combined_mean_gene[combined_mean_gene$Gene == gene, ]
    
    barplot_filename <- file.path(output_dir, paste0(tissue, "_", gene, "_mean_expr_by_celltype.png"))
    
    p_bar <- ggplot(combined_mean_gene, aes(x = Cell_Type, y = Mean_Expression, fill = Cell_Type)) +
      geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
      facet_wrap(~ Sample) +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
      theme(
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1)
      ) +
      labs(
        title = paste("Espressione Media per Cell Type:", gene),
        subtitle = paste("Tessuto:", tissue, "| Confronto tra campioni"),
        x = "Tipo Cellulare (new_cell_type)",
        y = "Espressione Media"
      )
    
    ggsave(barplot_filename, plot = p_bar, width = plot_width + 2, height = plot_height + 1, dpi = 300)
    
    message(paste("Grafici aggregati salvati per il gene:", gene))
  }
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3. SALVATAGGIO TABELLA FINALE CSV
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  if (length(mean_expr_list) > 0) {
    full_mean_df <- do.call(rbind, mean_expr_list)
    csv_filename <- file.path(output_dir, paste0(tissue, "_mean_expression_by_celltype.csv"))
    
    write.csv(full_mean_df, csv_filename, row.names = FALSE)
    message(paste("\nTabella espressione media salvata con successo in:", csv_filename))
    
    return(full_mean_df)
  } else {
    message("Nessun dato elaborato.")
    return(NULL)
  }
}
```


```{r}
counts_inspection(bin16_list_ann, fox0_samples, c("Foxo1","Foxo3","Trim63"), "fox0")
counts_inspection(bin16_list_ann, murf_samples, c("Foxo1","Foxo3","Trim63"), "murf")
counts_inspection(bin16_list_ann, smad_samples, c("Smad2","Smad3"), "smad")
counts_inspection(bin16_list_ann, smad_samples, c("Stat3"), "stat")

counts_inspection(bin16_list_ann, sham_samples, c("Foxo1","Foxo3","Trim63", "Stat3", "Smad2","Smad3"), "sham")
counts_inspection(bin16_list_ann, c26_samples, c("Foxo1","Foxo3","Trim63", "Stat3", "Smad2","Smad3"), "c26")
```
